				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><strong>Exceptional Accommodation</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>In an Exceptional Location</strong></h3>
<p>Puza Moya, located close to all our water sports activities, we provide everything you need for an unforgettable experience. Cape Sports Center is truly unique, offering a fantastic bar, delicious food, comfortable accommodation, equipment rentals, and—most importantly—our expert local knowledge and friendly, experienced team.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_0_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_button_alignment_tablet_left et_pb_button_alignment_phone_center et_pb_module ">
				<a class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_0 et_pb_bg_layout_light" href="#book" data-icon="5">Discover Our Accommodation</a>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="kitesurf" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_1 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1 et_pb_gutters2">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_0">
				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="800" height="204" src="https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Puza-Moya-Guest-house.png" alt="" title="Puza-Moya-Guest-house" srcset="https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Puza-Moya-Guest-house.png 800w, https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Puza-Moya-Guest-house-480x122.png 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) 800px, 100vw" class="wp-image-12068" /></span>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><strong>Across the road from the beach</strong>, 90m from the cape sports centre you will find <a href="https://puzamoyaguesthouse.za-southafrica.com/">Puza Moya</a> nestled into a quiet neighbourhood.</p>
<p>A carefully sculpted garden with plenty of trees welcomes you to the cool and serene accommodation.</p>
<p>You will have access to our <strong>private courtyard, kitchen and dining facilities.</strong></p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_1_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module ">

				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Located <strong>100m</strong> from the beach and the Cape Sport Center, Puza Moya Guest House in Langebaan offers <strong>en-suite rooms</strong>, a shared lounge and <strong>barbecue facilities.</strong></p>
<p>The rooms are equipped with a small fridge, tea-and-coffee making facilities and a bathroom with bath-and-shower combination. The guest house has a shared kitchen and a courtyard garden.</p>
<p><strong>Restaurants</strong> can be found about 1 km away at the main beach. An array of activities can be enjoyed in the surroundings, <strong>including windsurfing, kitesurfing, kayaking, cycling and fishing</strong>. The Langebaan <strong>Golf Club</strong> is a 5-minute drive away.</p>
<p><strong>Solar</strong> available for <strong>loadshedding</strong> (so no electricity interruptions!)</p></div>
			</div>
